# ankra_aws_vpcs (Data Source)

The VPCs of an AWS region, for `vpc_id` on `ankra_aws_cluster`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_aws_vpcs" "frankfurt" {
  credential_id = ankra_aws_role_credential.main.id
  region        = "eu-central-1"
}

locals {
  default_vpc_id = one([for vpc in data.ankra_aws_vpcs.frankfurt.vpcs : vpc.id if vpc.is_default])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credential_id` (String) Credential to read the catalogue through.
- `region` (String) AWS region, e.g. `eu-central-1` (`data.ankra_aws_regions`).

### Read-Only

- `vpcs` (Attributes List) VPCs of the region. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vpcs))

<a id="nestedatt--vpcs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vpcs`

Read-Only:

- `cidr` (String) Primary IPv4 CIDR.
- `id` (String) VPC id.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the region's default VPC.
- `name` (String) Name tag.
